 Order

This petition is filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. praying to enlarge the petitioner/accused on bail n a case registered at Maddur Police Station in Crime No.308/2022.
2.
Heard the learned counsel for petitioner and learned High Court Government Pleader for respondent/State and perused the material on record.

3. The aforementioned crime was registered against the petitioner and 5 others for an offence punishable under Section 302 read with 34 of IPC, on a complaint lodged by one Bibi Jan, wife of late Anwar Pasha.
4. The complaint averments reveal that the second daughter of the complainant, by name Husna Kouser married the petitioner in the year 2013 and it was a love marriage.
In their wedlock they have 3 children.
The petitioner was having illicit relationship with one Sayeda and he was ill-treating his wife and not looking after her properly.

On 29.11.2022 Husna Kouser along with her 3 NC:
2023:KHC:40654 minor children came to her parental home at Tumkur.
She informed her mother/complainant about the illicit relationship of her husband and also told her that she is unable to bear the torture.
The complainant consoled her.
On 30.11.2022, the complainant came to Maddur, to the house of the petitioner along with her daughter Husna Kouser and her grand children.
On the next day i.e., 01.12.2022 at about 10.00 a.m. she returned to Tumkur, after advising her daughter.
In the evening at about 5.00 p.m., when she called her daughter over phone, her daughter did not pick the call.
Therefore, she came to Maddur at about 7.00 p.m. and noticed that the door was locked.
When she opened the door, she found her daughter's dead body in a hanging position and her grand children were also found dead with froth coming out of the mouth.

5. In the complaint it is alleged that accused No.1 i.e., petitioner herein was having illicit relationship with accused No.6 and their relationship was supported by NC: 2023:KHC:40654 accused Nos.2 to 5 i.e., parents and brother of accused No.1 and wife of accused No.4.
It is further alleged that complainant's daughter and her three children were murdered by the accused persons.
On completion of investigation charge sheet has been filed for the offence punishable under Section 504, 323, 498A, 306 and 302 of IPC.
While filing the charge sheet, accused Nos.2 to 6 shown in the FIR have been dropped.
Charge sheet is filed against the petitioner/accused No.1 and deceased Husna Kouser.

6. It is the case of prosecution that accused No.1 was having illicit relationship with one Kashifa Khanum @ Sayeda and he was giving physical and mental torture to his deceased wife and when the deceased had requested him to discontinue the said illicit relationship, he had abused her and also Sri. sentences.text: Hence, she committed suicide by hanging herself, after killing her 3 minor children by smothering them.
The charge sheet material shows that the offences alleged against the petitioner is under Section 498A, 306, 504 and 323 of IPC.
Section 302 IPC is invoked against deceased Husna Kouser, who is alleged to have smothered her 3 minor children to death.
8. The learned High Court Government Pleader has pointed out that there are witnesses who speak about the illicit relationship between accused No.1 and Kashifa Khanum @ Sayeda.

It is therefore contended that in view of the said illicit relationship and the torture meted to the deceased and since the petitioner has abetted his wife to commit suicide, she has killed her 3 children and committed suicide.
9.
Whether the petitioner has intentionally aided or instigated his wife to commit suicide is a matter which has to be established during trial.
The prosecution has to establish that the petitioner either intentionally or by his conduct has aided or instigated the deceased to commit suicide.
The ingredients of abetment have to be proved NC: 2023:KHC:40654 during trial.
Now the Investigation is completed and charge sheet is filed.
The petitioner was arrested on 01.12.2022 and he is in judicial custody for nearly one year.
He has undertaken to furnish sufficient surety to ensure his regular presence before the trial Court and also undertaken to abide by other conditions.

Hence, the following:
ORDER Petition is allowed.

The petitioner/accused in S.C.No.72/2023 on the file of the Court of I Additional District and Sessions Judge, Mandya (Crime No.308/2022 of Maddur Police Station)
shall be enlarge on bail, subject to following conditions:
1. Petitioner shall execute a personal bond for a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh only) with two sureties for the likesum to the satisfaction of the jurisdictional Court.
